title: Waypoint::from_cbor accepts trailing garbage after a valid waypoint
description: Pre-existing decode leniency surfaced by 1vy1 review passes (decode path untouched there): ciborium::from_reader on a slice (waypoint.rs:391/429) accepts a valid waypoint followed by trailing bytes; the reject vectors in test/vectors/waypoint.json only cover truncation. Decide the contract for trailing bytes on the /waypoints decode path (reject vs accept-with-offset like CoAP block-wise payloads) and either add reject vectors or document the acceptance.
